title: Defense panel model, scheduling and conflict detection
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: src/lib/defense/conflicts.ts (pure): overlaps(a, b) = a.start < b.end && b.start < a.end; detectConflicts(panels) returns typed conflicts for (1) a chair or examiner in overlapping non-cancelled slots across different panels and (2) the same physical venue (case-insensitive, non-virtual) in overlapping slots. Unit tests including back-to-back slots (no conflict), cancelled slots and virtual venues.
models/defense-panel (schema, repo). If DefensePanelDocument has no publish flag add `is_published` and `published_at` (spec amendment A4a) and record it in the registry.

src/app/actions/manage-defense-panel.ts (coordinator/admin): create/update panel and slots. Examiners and chair must list the panel's course_id in programmes, otherwise cross_programme_justification is required and audited (defense.cross_programme). Only teams of the same course_id and status defense_ready can be slotted; one active slot per team.

src/app/actions/publish-defense-schedule.ts: refuses while detectConflicts finds any; sets is_published; notifies chair, examiners and team members (defense_schedule) with target_url /defense/{panelId} and the team's /deliverables link.
Server tests: cross-programme rule, wrong-course team rejected, conflict blocks publish, publish sends notifications.
acceptance: Publishing with a conflict returns an error listing the conflicts
